issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares messageOnFeed() as a public abstract method (UML visibility '+'), but the reference solution implements it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility difference could confuse students about the intended accessibility of the abstract method and its expected use from other classes (e.g., Farm invoking messageOnFeed()).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method visibility consistent with the UML/specification. Change the declaration in Animal.java to public abstract String messageOnFeed(); (or update the UML/problem text to indicate protected) so students clearly know the method should be public and callable from other classes per the specification.
